Name: Changing Seasons recolor
Author: ralmuce
Description:
[left]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23095]Soft Slow Seasons[/url]﻿, this mod is my take on a 12 seasons recolor. Now all seasons have three stages: Early, True and Late, each with slight color variation, so that the change of seasons seems less drastic. [/left][left]
[font=Arial][size=4][b]Mod features:[/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*]Grass, trees, bushes and snow were recolored to create 12 seasonal variants. Nothing else (like buildings, non-seasonal locations..) is affected and I tried to keep my changes somewhat vanilla-looking
[*]Early and Late stages are one week long and True is two weeks long
[*]True seasons are colored like this: Spring is blueish green, Summer is true green, Fall has desaturated green grass and yellow/red trees and bushes. Winter is blue
[*]Early and Late stages of the season are closer to the previous/next season's colors
[/list][/left][list]
[*]There is snow in Early Spring and Late Fall 
[*]Grass is dynamic: shorter in Winter and Spring and longer in Summer and Fall
[*]You can choose between recolored versions of vanilla foliage or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164?tab=description]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿ if you have the original mod installed
[/list]
[font=Arial][size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size][/font]

Compatible (and recommended!) mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164?tab=description]Simple Foliage[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15026]Simple Resources[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1966]Elle's Dirt and Cliff Recolor[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15175]Fall Leaves[/url] - I made the recolor with these mods in mind and you can see them in my screenshots
Also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29080]The Neighborly Collection[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] mods - SVE trees, (some of the) Cornucopia bushes and all of the snow overlays and random patches of grass on buildings should be recolored to fit in with the rest of the mod. 
Generally compatible with any other mod that doesn't add more grassy/snow tilesheets. 
NOT compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15707]MixedBag's Tilesheets[/url].
More compatibility is (probably) coming later﻿
